+    def _unescape_args_and_kwargs(self, name: str) -> str:
+        """Revert the escaping done by :meth:`_escape_args_and_kwargs`.
+
+        This is used when the (possibly escaped) name is going to be used
+        as an argument of a directive (e.g. ``.. attribute::`` or
+        ``.. method::``) instead of as part of a docutils field list.  In
+        the latter case the backslash escape is required to prevent
+        docutils from interpreting a trailing underscore as the start of a
+        hyperlink target, but directive arguments are not parsed for inline
+        markup so the backslash would otherwise show up literally in the
+        rendered output.
+        """
+        return re.sub(r'\\([*_])', r'\1', name)
